Yã sã 46*cfa0.5 = cfa<<46*0.5=23>>23 lã tùun ɛ.
Tã tùun yã 3-2 = <<3-2=1>>1. Yã sã 26*cfa0.5 = cfa<<26*0.5=13>>13 lã yã. Bã sã 1 * 13 = <<1*13=13>>13
Kɛ bã sã yã yã tùun wã cfa28 + cfa23 + cfa13= cfa<<28+23+13=64>>64.
